annotations.title: Apply a compliance profile to an image

description: Marks an AI-generated or human-made image with a compliance profile: a signed C2PA manifest with the profile's disclosure, an invisible watermark (the AI profiles), an ISCC fingerprint registered with Proofestry, and a trusted timestamp when the signing provider has one. Returns the marked file (base64 in the REST response; a short-lived download link over MCP). Marking the same image again is idempotent: it returns the same asset id and never creates a second record. Profiles help meet obligations and do not guarantee compliance; they are in beta until the signer is on the C2PA trust list. An image that already carries Content Credentials is kept as the parent of the new manifest (existing_credentials=reject refuses it). Images up to 1 MiB inline (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC); larger files use the upload job routes. Failed calls are never charged. MCP tool: `mark_content`. Price: 0.01 USDC per image.

existing_credentials.description: What to do with an image that already carries Content Credentials: `preserve` (default) keeps them as the parent of the new manifest, so their history and signature stay in the file; `reject` refuses the image with 409.
existing_credentials.title: Existing Credentials

invisible_watermark.description: provenance-only: also embed the invisible watermark. The AI profiles always do.
invisible_watermark.title: Invisible Watermark

ledger_id.description: Add the asset to this ledger for the compliance report. Needs `Authorization: Bearer <ledger token>`.
ledger_id.title: Ledger Id

strip_metadata.title: Strip Metadata
